tasks.text: Flash flooding in Canmore, Alberta (51.0884, -115.3479). About 30 people are stranded on rooftops near Cougar Creek after the creek burst its banks.
tasks.reason: this report is already stored and has not been run yet
tasks.title: Flash flooding in Canmore, Alberta

plan.rationale: Given the high severity and 30 estimated people, all available drones are deployed for maximum search coverage using an efficient lawnmower pattern. Both robodogs are sent to assist with ground-level search, and all available helicopters are dispatched for rescue, though their capacity is limited for the number of people expected.

debrief.summary: The mission was completed in 110.1 simulated minutes, successfully rescuing all 20 people.
